coverage: Evidence-backed supplemental seed, including five re-reviewed historical case studies; not exhaustive. No season has been fully audited.

events.game: Denver Broncos at Oakland Raiders — Broncos 41–14
events.timing_precision: The Denver Post page is dated Sept. 10, 2008 but also shows Updated May 7, 2016; the footnote version time is not separately shown. MyFantasyLeague posted its correction explainer Sept. 11, 2008. Exact NFL system timestamp unavailable.
events.reason: The Denver Post says official review of game footage credited one additional passing yard on a fourth-quarter completion to Nate Jackson. The accessible NFL gamebook still lists 299.

changes.subject: Jay Cutler
changes.scope: game total; reported correction versus accessible gamebook snapshot

events.impact: A one-yard change could cross a Cutler passing-yard prop or 300-yard threshold and potentially Nate Jackson’s receiving-yard line if offered; Jackson’s exact before/after total was not established. Denver beat Oakland 41–14; the final score did not change. No sportsbook line or settlement is verified.
flags: Material version conflict: the accessible official NFL gamebook lists 299 while the Denver Post footnote and MyFantasyLeague report give 300. The Denver Post page shows a 2016 update, so the footnote’s original publication time is not independently established. The PDF has no visible update date; exact provenance and official correction notice remain unresolved.

events.game: St. Louis Rams at New York Giants — Giants 28–16
events.timing_precision: A Fleaflicker forum post at 8:11 p.m. on Sept. 21 reported the NFL credit; that is not an NFL-system timestamp.
events.reason: Contemporaneous reports describe the fourth-down play as initially called incomplete with defensive pass interference. The final NFL gamebook credits Nicks with a 23-yard catch at 6:37 of Q1, fourth-and-four at the Rams 32, with PI declined. The official notice and review rationale were not located.
events.impact: Manning completion/passing-yard and Nicks reception/receiving-yard markets could be affected if offered. The same drive ended in a Giants touchdown; final score remained 28–16. Fleaflicker declined to retroactively rescore its Tuesday-finalized Week 2 fantasy results; no sportsbook settlement is verified.
flags: The exact NFL correction timestamp and internal review notice were not found. The forum records a provider’s report of the correction and its own fantasy rescore decision, not a sportsbook outcome.

events.game: New York Giants at New Orleans Saints — Saints 52–49
events.timing_precision: ESPN reported the Elias correction on Monday, Nov. 2 and followed up Nov. 4. The exact NFL database timestamp was not located.
events.reason: ESPN reports that Elias reclassified Snead’s fourth-quarter catch/fumble as an interception because he never had full control. The same 63-yard Giants return remained a touchdown; only the turnover type changed.
events.impact: Brees completion, passing-yard and interception markets; Snead reception, receiving-yard and fumble markets; and Giants defensive-interception/return markets could be affected if offered. ESPN reported a two-point fantasy deduction for Brees in many standard scoring formats; that is not sportsbook settlement evidence. Final score stayed Saints 52, Giants 49, and the same 63-yard return TD remained.
flags: NJ.com reported 504 passing yards; the NFL final gamebook and ESPN’s final box score list 505. This record uses 505 and preserves the conflict. No sportsbook line or settlement was verified.

events.game: Dallas Cowboys at Indianapolis Colts — Colts 23–0
events.timing_precision: The legacy NFL Fantasy correction entry is indexed with a Dec. 19 date; contemporary coverage appeared Dec. 20. The exact internal review time is not established.
events.reason: At 14:15 of Q2, on fourth-and-1 at IND 3, final NFL play-by-play records Elliott for −2 yards to IND 5, fumbles after a P. Desir hit, and recovers at IND 5. Secondary reports say the initial box score credited Jabaal Sheard with the recovery; no primary public explanation for the re-attribution was located.

changes.subject: Ezekiel Elliott
changes.scope: game total; the fumble remains in the final NFL book

events.impact: Elliott fumbles-lost/own-recovery, potential defensive recovery and fantasy outcomes could be affected if offered. The fourth-down attempt failed either way, so possession and the Colts 23–0 final score did not change. Contemporary fantasy coverage reports some league matchups changed; no sportsbook line or settlement is verified.
flags: The fumble itself was not removed: the final NFL book lists 1 FUM, 0 LOST, 1 OWN-REC. The official correction route now redirects; its Dec. 19 date comes from the indexed entry. The rationale for changing the recovery attribution remains secondary reporting, not a located NFL explanation.
